slot.brief: Show a figure of an ozonolysis: given ozonolysis products (carbonyls), reconstruct the alkene structure

stem: The carbonyl products shown are obtained by reductive ozonolysis of an alkene. Which alkene was used?

verdicts.working: Reductive ozonolysis of methylenecyclopentane cleaves the exocyclic double bond to give cyclopentanone and formaldehyde, matching the products shown.

working:
$\text{R}_2\text{C} = \text{CR}_2 \xrightarrow{\text{O}_3,\ \text{reductive workup}}$ cleavage at the double bond. The terminal $\text{CH}_2$ gives methanal; the ring carbon gives cyclopentanone. Hence the alkene is methylenecyclopentane.

Independent check: Reductive ozonolysis of methylenecyclopentane cleaves the exocyclic double bond to give cyclopentanone and formaldehyde, matching the products shown.
solution: Reductive ozonolysis cleaves the double bond, converting each alkene carbon into a carbonyl carbon. An exocyclic $\text{CH}_2$ gives methanal, while the ring carbon gives cyclopentanone; this corresponds to methylenecyclopentane.

Place a plus sign between them. Add the caption “products of reductive ozonolysis” below the structures.
